cohort: The study included 1178 low-risk women allocated to either a midwife-led continuity of care group or a shared model of care comparison group.
finding: Women in the midwife-led continuity of care group were more likely to have a spontaneous vaginal birth and their neonates were less likely to be preterm compared to women in the shared model of care group.
mod_finding: Women receiving midwife-led continuity of care were more likely to have a spontaneous vaginal birth.
